caption:
Anthropic stock's first day: the biggest IPO ever closed at $97.17, up 17% from its $83 price, after opening up 34%. Its two biggest outside owners fell: Amazon −3.9%, Alphabet −3.5%, as the S&P 500 lost 2% for a sixth straight drop.
